description.default: Drag Markdown files, whole folders or ZIP archives from your file manager onto SiYuan's document tree: the folder structure becomes documents, images and attachments are uploaded and linked, name conflicts can be replaced or appended, and any import can be undone for 30 seconds.
description.zh-CN: 从资源管理器把 md、整个文件夹或 zip 拖到文档树，松手就是一篇篇文档，层级原样还原。图片与附件自动上传并改写链接，同名冲突可选覆盖或追加，整批导入 30 秒内可撤销。
